title: Shopping is moving to AI agents, and our store must be ready for them
summary: Amazon: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping, spending 50% more. NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery. Walmart added agent spend limits. Asus sees commercial PC prices up ~10% in 2H26; Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028.

points.headline: AI assistants now drive discovery and higher spend at scale
points.detail: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more; NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery. Our product content and catalog must be readable and purchasable by assistants.

points.headline: Retailers are building agent trust and holding discovery in-house
points.detail: Walmart added spending limits for agent purchases; Target centers holiday on its AI assistant. We should plan agent checkout controls and check how our listings appear to agents.

points.headline: Memory shortage lifts PC prices and keeps overall demand weak
points.detail: Asus expects Taiwan commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26; Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028; Intel AI PCs grow as the market shrinks. We should plan pricing and inventory.

points.headline: Apple ends its touchscreen holdout with an OLED MacBook Pro
points.detail: Apple shows pricey touchscreen laptops, with Samsung Display as sole panel source. We should review our premium laptop positioning and online pricing against it.

points.headline: Walmart stretches Black Friday and Cyber Monday to 14 days
points.detail: Walmart extends its events from 10 to 14 days. We should check our deal calendar and price-matching against it.
